# sspi_role_binding (Data Source)

Fetches an SSPI role binding, either by its `id` or by the exact `entity_name` (optionally narrowed with `user_type`) it was granted to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sspi_role_binding" "by_name" {
  entity_name = "Administrators"
  user_type   = "REMOTE_GROUP"
}

data "sspi_role_binding" "by_id" {
  id = "e3f5a0f9-d63e-4e89-bb42-27538c20621a"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `entity_name` (String) Exact name of the user or group the roles were granted to. Exactly one of `id` or `entity_name` must be set.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the role binding. Exactly one of `id` or `entity_name` must be set.
- `user_type` (String) The kind of entity: `LOCAL_USER`, `REMOTE_USER` or `REMOTE_GROUP`. When looking up by `entity_name`, set this to disambiguate if the same name exists with more than one type.

### Read-Only

- `roles` (Set of String) The roles held by the entity.
